title: Profile
description: A curated preset of things a group of people is known to have made or done. In the tool these are 'selected'; everything else that follows from them is 'reachable'. Users start from a profile and toggle items on or off.

region.description: A label for where the group lived, for people to read. The profile's area comes from `place` (ADR 0052).

period.description: A label for when, for people to read ("c. 2050–1650 BCE"). The years the reasoning uses are `years` (ADR 0052).

place.description: Where the group lived: a Cliopatria entity, by its name as Cliopatria writes it. The profile's area is the union of the entity's polygons in the rows whose years overlap `years`, and the sources found inside it, worked by the profile's last year, count as had (ADR 0052).

years.description: When: [from, to], signed years, inclusive (negative is BCE, no year 0; ADR 0051). A source counts as had when one of its occurrences in the area was worked by `to`.

items.description: Something the group is known to have made or done: a thing ({id}) or an action ({verb, target}).
